{"consolidated_memory":"CORRUPTED SCAFFOLD IN cli/commands/init.py — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Both incidents manifested the same symptom: a generated tree missing one file when running the init command in a directory that already has a lockfile. Both are covered by tests/cli/test_init.py. Both are developer tooling side issues in Python.

INCIDENT 1: [2026-02-21] UNICODE NORMALISATION ISSUE
- File: cli/commands/init.py
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR: #2687 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-2
- Environment: staging read replica only
- Outcome: reclaimed 8 GB of blob storage

INCIDENT 2: [2026-04-08] OFF-BY-ONE SLICE BOUND ISSUE
- File: cli/commands/init.py
- Root cause: an off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR: #5184 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-4
- Environment: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Outcome: memory settled at 933 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB

Both repro steps: init into a directory that already has a lockfile
Both test coverage: tests/cli/test_init.py"}
